evidence.evidenceSnippet: AyudantIA is UC's institutional project: teachers create AI chatbot agents with course information and content, as 24/7 virtual tutors in a secure and teacher-validated environment. It is in implementation/pilot across participating UC courses and units.

claims.claimText: When instructors allow generative AI use, UC guidance tells them to promote personal-data protection by avoiding feeding AI tools names, grades, or other private or sensitive information.
claims.claimValue: avoid entering student personal or sensitive data into AI tools

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Promueve la protección de datos personales evitando alimentar a la IA con nombres, calificaciones o cualquier otra información privada o sensible.
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: The guidance says to protect personal data by avoiding feeding AI with names, grades, or private/sensitive information.

claims.claimText: UC's academic-integrity guidance says instructors should clearly and transparently determine permitted and prohibited uses of generative AI, and treats unauthorized AI use in a course as an academic-integrity violation.
claims.claimValue: unauthorized AI use is an academic-integrity issue when course rules disallow it

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Determina con claridad y transparencia las formas y usos permitidos y no permitidos de la IA... El uso no autorizado de herramientas de IA en el contexto de un curso, se considera una falta a la Integridad Académica.
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: The page tells instructors to define permitted and prohibited AI uses; it says unauthorized AI use in a course is an academic-integrity violation.

claims.claimText: UC's academic-integrity guidance recommends avoiding generative-AI detection tools because their reliability has not been demonstrated and false positives can significantly affect students.
claims.claimValue: avoid AI detection tools due to reliability concerns

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Evita usar herramientas de detección de IA, dado que su confiabilidad no ha sido demostrada y un falso positivo puede generar un gran impacto.
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: The guidance recommends avoiding AI detection tools because reliability has not been demonstrated and false positives can have major impact.
evidence.snippetLocation: Evita usar herramientas de detección de IA
